review:
The Floating Dragon series at its busiest. Six reels, with three extra rows at the top that can unlock at random, so the grid's shape changes from spin to spin – golden toads, lanterns and red envelopes across up to 147,456 ways.

Mystery symbols reveal matching icons and wins cascade away. Two bonuses, as usual: free spins from three scatters, and a Hold & Spin with cash prizes. 96.7% RTP. A lot going on every spin.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
